Come Book & stay at a Modern 3-Story East Nashville Retreat | Rooftop + Luxury Finishes

10 minutes to Broadway – Honky-tonks, live music, and nightlife

5 minutes to Nissan Stadium – Catch the Titans or your favorite concert

The space
This 3-bed 4-bath home is 3 stories with a full kitchen, two living rooms, indoor and outdoor dining and a rooftop patio.
